thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: routing-service anomaly detected: rapid fallback loop + model-variant inconsistency for policy 'smart-route-qc'. Paging on-call.

jules: I'm on it. Seeing a spike in 502s from route-proxy and a lot of immediate retries. Traces: https://logs.redwood.internal/trace/abc123

leo_k: Which regions and models are hit? Any customer reports?

maria_s: Two customers reported bad outputs: MediFlow (eu-west tenant) and VendorPortal (ap-south). CS ticket numbers MF-1987, VP-776. Symptoms: models flip mid-response and hallucinate new instruction tokens, latency 600-1200ms.

oncall-bot: @jules assigned (pager). Escalation policy: primary->secondary in 6 minutes.

jules: quick debug notes: routing path does lookup: cache.get("model_variant|region|policy") expected but code currently uses cache.get("model|region") after yesterday's refactor. So cached bindings don't reflect policy alias changes. Also found policy 'smart-route-qc' introduced an alias swap for 'dex-7b' to 'dex-7b-q8' without bumping policy compatibility flag. Combined with fallback rules that allow cross-region variant substitution we see a loop: eu-west forwards to global, global falls back to ap-south, then ap-south back to eu-west because of alias mapping mismatch.

leo_k: Good catch. That would make cache hits return a variant that policy would later override, causing proxy to drop/redirect and trigger retries.

maria_s: Any immediate mitigation we can do to stop customer impact?

jules: Proposed runbook: 1) pause cross-region fallback in the routing console 2) set routing policy to read-only (no alias changes) 3) purge affected cache keys in eu-west+global for models dex-7b and dex-7b-q8 4) pin MediFlow and VendorPortal routes to explicit variant until we validate.

ops-bot: snippet to check keys (dry-run):
```
redis-cli -h kv-eu-west-1 --scan --pattern "cache:model:dex-7b:*" | wc -l
redis-cli -h kv-global-1 --scan --pattern "cache:model:dex-7b:*" | head -n 5
```

jules: Running dry-run shows ~230 keys across eu-west and ~190 global keys that look like pre-rollout bindings. I will pause fallback now.

jules: Paused cross-region fallback for 'smart-route-qc' via admin console. Confirmed flag: allow_cross_region=false.

jules: Purging keys in eu-west first. Deleted 232 keys. Purging global next. Deleted 188 keys.

leo_k: Pinning MediFlow and VendorPortal routes to 'dex-7b-q8@2026-03-15' via route API. Confirmed.

maria_s: CS update sent to both customers: "We've applied mitigations, pinned routes, and are investigating root cause; we'll follow up with remediation credits if applicable."

jules: Observability after purge: error rate on routing-proxy eu-west dropped from 6.2% -> 0.6% over 10 minutes. Latency for affected tenants back to baseline. Traces no longer show variant bounce.

oncall-bot: Incident status: severity=sev2, responders=[jules, leo_k, maria_s], incident_id=INC-2102, status=mitigated

leo_k: Root cause summary: policy alias swap plus refactor bug meant cache keys lacked policy/version namespace. Result: stale cache entries with old variant bindings were reused after alias change, mismatching policy evaluation and triggering fallback hops. The fallback rules then allowed cross-region substitutions leading to quick retry loops.

jules: Temporary mitigations applied. Next steps / action items (ticket RED-3421):
- include policy_id + policy_version in cache keying schema (backwards-incompatible, needs migration plan)
- add unit/integration test that simulates alias changes and verifies cache invalidation behavior
- add realtime alert when >0.5% of traces show cache_hit.variant != policy_decision.variant within 5m
- make alias changes require an explicit cache-invalidation step or automatic namespacing change

maria_s: Also recommend a customer communications template and credit calc for CS: estimate affected window 09:05–09:22 UTC, approx 12-18% of requests for tenants in eu-west; suggest 10% credit applied automatically for those tenants.

jules: Adding trace ids to INC-2102 and attaching redis key lists. Handover: I'll be on the postmortem and assist with the KV key migration plan. @leo_k will own adding the alert and tests. @maria_s will coordinate customer comms and credits.

incident-bot: Closing active page. Postmortem required within 72 hours.

jules: Closing thread. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
